title: Caddyfile Transpiler Specification
description: Specification and mapping contract for transpiling Nginx and Apache web server configurations into idiomatic Caddyfile configurations.

presets.name: React / Vue SPA (HTML5 History Mode Fallback)

advisory_rules.title: Automatic HTTPS Enabled
advisory_rules.description: Caddy automatically provisions, configures, and renews TLS certificates (via Let's Encrypt / ZeroSSL). Explicit ssl_certificate / SSLCertificateFile directives are removed as redundant.

advisory_rules.title: Native WebSocket Support
advisory_rules.description: Caddy reverse_proxy handles WebSocket upgrade headers and connection state automatically out-of-the-box without requiring proxy_set_header Upgrade/Connection.

advisory_rules.title: Custom Request Body Size
advisory_rules.description: Custom max body size limits (e.g. client_max_body_size or LimitRequestBody) should be configured in Caddy using the request_body directive (e.g. request_body { max_size <size> }).

advisory_rules.title: PHP-FPM Router Consolidation
advisory_rules.description: Complex try_files, fastcgi_pass, fastcgi_param, and SCRIPT_FILENAME directives are simplified into a single php_fastcgi directive.

advisory_rules.title: Modern Compression (Zstandard & Gzip)
advisory_rules.description: In Caddy, enable high-performance compression with 'encode zstd gzip' instead of lengthy gzip/brotli modules.

test_vectors.description: Nginx reverse proxy with headers and SSL

test_vectors.input:
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On
RewriteRule ^old-blog/(.*)$ /posts/$1 [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^api/v1/(.*)$ /api/v2/$1 [R=302,L]
</IfModule>

Header set X-Frame-Options "DENY"
Header set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
